title: Jurassic Jigsaw
description: Assemble image tiles by matching edges, then search for sea monsters in the composed image.
writeup:
## Approach

A jigsaw puzzle: match tile edges (including rotations and flips), assemble the image, and search for a pattern.

## Part 1

Build an edge-to-tile lookup. Corner tiles are those with exactly 2 edges that match another tile (the other 2 edges are on the border). Multiply their IDs.

## Part 2

Assemble the full image:
1. Pick a corner tile and orient it so shared edges face right and down.
2. Fill the top row left-to-right by matching each tile's left edge to its neighbor's right edge.
3. Fill remaining rows top-to-bottom by matching top edges.
4. Crop tile borders and stitch into one large image.

Then try all 8 orientations of the assembled image and count sea monster matches using coordinate offsets from the monster pattern. The water roughness is the total `#` count minus the cells covered by monsters.
